sections.title: Section 1: Complaints To Clifton Antiques
sections.html:
deliver >> delivery (n)

(verb). gửi, giao đồ

I'm waiting for them to deliver my package from the post office.

transit

(noun). quá trình vận chuyển

The goods are in transit.

parcel

(noun). kiện hàng

He left the parcel in front of my door.

warehouse

(noun). nhà kho

They keep a lot of things inside the warehouse.

insurance

(noun). bảo hiểm

Having health insurance can really help you if you suddenly become sick and cannot work anymore.

claim

(verb). lấy tiền bảo hiểm

I claimed my insurance money by showing the insurance company my hospital bill.

go missing

(verb). đi lạc, bị thất lạc

The police are looking for the girl who went missing a few days ago.

furniture

(noun). đồ nội thất

The first thing I did when I moved into my new house was buying new furniture for the living room.

valuable

(adjective). quý giá

A good idea can be very valuable.

antique

(adjective). đồ cổ

My father likes to visit the antique store, even though he doesn't buy anything.

bowl

(noun). tô, chén

You can keep the food in this glass bowl.

painting

(noun). bức tranh

The painting shows a nice autumn day in the city.

decorative

(adjective). mang tính trang trí

I'd love to buy some decorative cushions to put on my sofa.

replace

(verb). thay thế, thế chỗ

Do you think that robots will someday replace humans in the workplace?

drawer

(noun). ngăn kéo

This wooden cabinet has five drawers.

dent

(noun). vết lõm

This dent on my car is from the traffic accident last week.

unusable

(adjective). không sử dụng được

These toothbrushes are so old now that they're basically unusable.

repair

(verb). sửa chữa

He's repairing the old iPhone.

split

(verb). chia ra, tách ra

I split the candy bar in half so I can give one half to my brother.

padding

(noun). đệm bông, đệm lót

The jacket has paddings on the inside to help keep you warm.

crockery

(noun). đồ bếp, ly chén đĩa

My mom likes to collect crockery sets.

smash

(verb). đập vỡ

Someone smashed the window of the store last night.

quantity

(noun). số lượng

When it comes to ideas, quality is better than quantity.

ensure

(verb). đảm bảo

Wearing a helmet helps to ensure the safety of builders.

refund

(noun). hoàn tiền

I returned the product and the store gave me a refund.

purchase

(verb). mua

I enjoy purchasing goods online because I don't have a lot of time to go out shopping.

sections.title: Section 2: A Popular Holiday Region: Treloar Valley
sections.html:
ferry

(noun). phà

The ferry is taking tourists to the island.

depart >> departure (n)

(verb). khởi hành, rời bến

The plane departs at 9AM and will arrive 3 hours later.

operate

(verb). tổ chức, quản lý

There are many things to consider when operating your own store.

differ

(verb). khác nhau

Opinions differ on this issue.

tide >> tidal (adj)

(noun). thủy triều

The tide is quite strong tonight.

seasonal

(adjective). theo mùa

Berries are seasonal fruits and only available in the summer.

cruise

(noun). tàu du lịch

I want to go on a cruise for my vacation next year.

combine

(verb). kết hợp

First, let's combine the sugar into the water.

route

(noun). đường chạy

There's a beautiful bike route here which is right next to the lake.

wheelchair

(noun). xe lăn

She can't walk, so she uses a wheelchair to move around.

rail track

(noun). đường ray

Crossing the rail track is extremely dangerous.

booking

(noun). việc đặt chỗ, việc mua vé trước

Our travel agent helps us to make bookings for our travel plans.

commuter

(noun). người đi tàu, người đi xe buýt

She's a subway commuter.

viaduct

(noun). cầu cạn, cầu vượt

This viaduct helps to connect the traffic between both sides of the river.

tower over

(verb). vượt xa, cao hơn rất nhiều so với những thứ xung quanh

The Landmark 81 building towers over its surrounding neighborhood.

fare

(noun). giá vé

You have to pay the bus fare when you get on the bus.

valid

(adjective). hợp lý, chấp nhận được, chính đáng

Being sick is a valid reason for you to stay home.

unlimited

(adjective). không giới hạn

At a buffet, you can pay a fixed amount of money to enjoy an unlimited amount of food.

lay-by

(noun). bãi đậu xe, chỗ đậu xe bên đường

Why don't we park the car in the lay-by over there?

household

(adjective). liên quan đến việc nhà

She spent the entire day doing household chores.

cross

(verb). băng qua, vượt qua

You have to be careful when you cross the road with young children.

mill

(noun). cối xay gió

Holland is famous for its old mills.

renovate

(verb). cải tiến, sửa chữa lại

We're trying to renovate our kitchen by ourselves.

arts and crafts

(noun). đồ thủ công

On this table, we have everything ready to make some arts and crafts.

potter

(noun). người làm gốm

He's an experienced potter and has been making clay pots and vases for years.

refreshment

(noun). đồ giải khát

Please enjoy some light refreshment we have prepared on the table.

landscape

(noun). phong cảnh, tranh phong cảnh

The landscape of this area is simply amazing.

explore

(verb). khám phá

When I grow up, I want to travel and explore the world.

estuary

(noun). cửa sông

The river water changes color when it mixes with the sea water in the estuary.

sections.title: Section 3: Research On Web-Based Crosswords
sections.html:
familiar

(adjective). quen thuộc

The children are familiar with the puzzle so it shouldn't take long for them to finish it.

cover

(verb). bao gồm

There was so much to cover in the presentation that it went on for hours.

straightforward

(adjective). dễ hiểu, không phức tạp

The process is very straightforward: you just need to follow these three steps and then it's done.

concept

(noun). khái niệm

When you think of trees, your mind will use different examples of trees that you've seen to make a general concept.

persuade / convince

(verb). thuyết phục

She persuaded them to listen to her ideas.

participant

(noun). người tham gia

There were nine participants in the meeting.

questionnaire

(noun). trắc nghiệm, bản điều tra

A questionnaire shouldn't be too long, or else people won't want to complete it.

misleading

(adjective). gây hiểu nhầm

Advertisements can be quite misleading sometimes.

obsolete

(adjective). lạc hậu, lỗi thời

Mobile phones have made home phones completely obsolete.

take aback

(adjective). gây ngạc nhiên

She was taken aback by what she just saw.

disappointed

(adjective). thất vọng

He's disappointed because he lost his job.

complex

(adjective). phức tạp, khó hiểu

The new problem is so complex that he cannot possibly solve it on his own.

distracted

(adjective). bị phân tâm

I tried to focus on my homework, but I kept getting distracted by my phone.

respondent

(noun). người trả lời

Would you like to be a respondent to our short survey?

highlight

(verb). nhấn mạnh

The teacher highlighted the main ideas in the textbook, which we will need to study for the test.

gender

(noun). giới tính

Do you know the gender of the baby yet?

assessment

(noun). bài đánh giá, kiểm tra

We have an assessment at the end of the course

reference

(verb). chú thích tham khảo

Don't forget to reference your sources at the end of your paper.

collaborate

(verb). hợp tác

Everyone in the team needs to collaborate on this project.

instrument

(noun). công cụ

When working in a lab, you need to get used to all these different scientific instruments.

acknowledge

(verb). công nhận

It feels good when others acknowledge the good work that you've done for them.

crossword

(noun). ô chữ

There's a new crossword in the newspaper every day.

revise >> revision (n)

(verb). ôn tập

She has a lot to revise before the final exam.

article

(noun). bài báo

Have you seen this article in paper today?

apprentice

(noun). người tập sự

He's working as an apprentice in the workshop.

sections.title: Section 4: Time Perspectives
sections.html:
failure

(noun). sự thất bại

He's tried many times but it always ended in failure.

nostalgia

(noun). sự nhớ quá khứ, sự luyến tiếc

When I look at old pictures of me and my childhood, I have a strong feeling of nostalgia.

fancy

(verb). thích làm gì đó

My grandmother fancies having a cup of tea every morning.

regret

(noun). sự hối hận

He has many regrets in his life.

seek

(verb). tìm kiếm

He decided to seek the opinion of a co-worker on the problem.

avoid

(verb). tránh né

We should avoid shaking hands in order to keep ourselves safe from the spread of COVID-19.

motto

(noun). châm ngôn

I have a poster of my life motto on the wall of my room.

govern

(verb). quy định, quản lý, chi phối

Russia has been governed by Vladimir Putin.

circumstance

(noun). hoàn cảnh, tình huống

Our flight was cancelled because of terrible weather circumstances.

poverty

(noun). sự nghèo khổ

Poverty is a big problem in many countries.

prohibit

(verb). ngăn cản, cấm đoán

The museum prohibits visitors from smoking indoors.

temptation

(noun). cám dỗ, sự dụ dỗ

Many people find that money is the most attractive temptation.

resist

(verb). chống lại

I'm on a diet so I'm always resisting the urge to eat chocolate.

judgement

(noun). sự phán xét

We are still waiting for the final judgement from the court.

initial

(adjective). đầu tiên

After the initial success of their app, the company released it to tablets, cellphones, and smartwatches too.

demand

(noun). nhu cầu

Demand for food is always increasing over time.

intelligent

(adjective). thông minh

My little brother is very bright and intelligent.

evidence

(noun). bằng chứng

In many criminal cases, fingerprints have been used as evidence.

drop out (of school)

(verb). bỏ học

More and more students are dropping out of school every year.

detrimental

(adjective). gây hại, có hại

We should know how to protect ourselves from the detrimental effects of air pollution.

insist

(verb). khăng khăng đòi, nhấn mạnh điều gì đó

They both insist that the other person must follow their way.

persistent >> persistently (adv)

(adjective). kiên trì

Being persistent helps you to reach your goal.

virtuous

(adjective). đạo đức, đúng đắn

He tries to lead a right and virtuous life.

careless

(adjective). cẩu thả, bất cần

Don't be so careless when crossing the street, or you may get into an accident.

identify

(verb). xác minh, nhận diện

How can we identify the right person we are looking for?

vital

(adjective). quan trọng

It's vital to keep following social distancing guidelines.

personality

(noun). tính cách

Everyone has a different personality, so it's always exciting to meet new people.

distinction

(noun). sự khác biệt

The third chair has the distinction of being more expensive and more comfortable.

perspective

(noun). quan điểm, góc nhìn

Everyone has a different perspective on the problem.

conflict

(noun). mâu thuẫn

They have a lot of conflicts at home.

cooperation

(noun). sự hợp tác

We need the cooperation of every team member for this project.

consequence

(noun). hậu quả

If you do something bad, you will get the consequence later.

fate

(noun). số mệnh

Do you believe that fate will bring you and the one you love together?

indicate

(verb). chỉ ra, cho biết

The R rating indicates that this movie is not suitable for children.

fundamental

(adjective). cơ bản

Making a fire is one of the most fundamental skills to learn when going camping.

approach

(noun). cách tiếp cận

Let's think of the best approach to this problem.
